create_process_group_stats_monitor: create a ProcessGroupStatsMonitor that spawns a subprocess to collect per-process-group CPU, memory, disk IO, and network stats
use_process_group_resource_usage: use the ProcessGroupResourceUsage dataclass to inspect CPU percent, RSS, PSS, private bytes, disk IO, and network bytes snapshots
collect_pgrp_stats_with_callback: collect process-group resource stats at a fixed interval by passing an async callback to ProcessGroupStatsMonitor
monitor_multi_rank_training_resources: monitor per-rank resource usage in multi-rank training where ranks share a single cgroup but have separate PGIDs
parse_proc_smaps_rollup: parse /proc/[pid]/smaps_rollup to extract PSS and private memory bytes for accurate physical memory accounting
